title: Appendix containing Canons and Rulings not having Conciliar Origin but Approved by Name in Canon II. of the Synod in Trullo: Of the Same to Menas the Bishop

verses.text:
Of the Same to Menas the
Bishop.

Theophilus was informed, that the priest in Geminus, a
village, had repelled Kyradium (a woman) from the communion: 
Theophilus approves of it, because she had done wrong, and was
unwilling to make satisfaction; but orders her to be admitted to
communion upon repentance.
